The Water Cycle

Water moves continuously between the ocean, atmosphere and land. Evaporation occurs when sunlight heats water in rivers, lakes and the sea. The water vapour rises and forms clouds. When clouds become heavy enough, water falls as rain or snow.

expectations.criterion: The adaptedContent is grammatically correct isiZulu and accurately conveys the water cycle information from the English source.

rubric: Evaluate whether the isiZulu text is fluent and captures evaporation, water vapour, clouds, and precipitation.

South Africa's Biomes

South Africa has nine major biomes. The Savanna covers 33% of the country's land surface. The Fynbos biome, found mostly in the Western Cape, is home to over 9 000 plant species, 70% of which are endemic.
